notes: Mid America Motorworks lists 9427651 as GM reference for 1973-1974 front grille mounting screws (set of 12, black oxide) and also as an alternate number in a 1975-1979 parking light grille kit (primary GM 3846854; black phosphate flat head self-tapping). No thread/length given in any snippet; MAM pages returned 404 on fetch. Round 3 (2026-10-26): AMK and size searches found nothing new; a CorvetteForum owner guessed '#10 washer head screw, approx 3/4" long' for 73 grille screws (unverified, not recorded). Round 4: Paragon 13518K (GM 9427651 / 3846854): (12) Phillips head screws & (12) black phosphate U-nuts; still no thread/length. The U-nut 3846854 is #10-16 per GM catalog, but that doesn't fix this screw's size.
